name: Cold Bobcat 20
author: Admin12121
description: Red radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from hsl(0 0% 0%) to hsl(0 0% 20%). Clicking it toggles it: background changes from hsl(0 0% 0%) to hsl(0 0% 20%). On focus, outline-color becomes #ff0000.
